DIPALI KOTHAWADE kothawadedipali97@gmail.com| Mob: +91 9371763946

CAREER OBJECTIVE Power Platform Developer with 3+ years of hands-on experience in designing and delivering business process automation, Microsoft Teams chatbots, and AI-powered workflows using Power Automate and Copilot Studio. Strong expertise in email automation, Teams-based conversational bots, Dataverse integrations, and Power Apps, helping organizations improve productivity and reduce manual effort through intelligent automation.

PROFILE SUMMARY:

Designed and implemented Copilot Studio chatbots integrated with Microsoft Teams to handle employee queries and process requests.

Built Power Automate flows to summarize incoming emails, extract key information, and post actionable insights directly into Teams.

Automated business workflows using approval flows, scheduled automations, and Teams notifications, reducing response time significantly.

Developed Canvas and Model-Driven Apps integrated with Dataverse and SharePoint Online. • Created Power BI dashboards to track automation KPIs and operational performance. • Collaborated with business users to identify automation opportunities and deliver scalable solutions. • Developed and maintained PowerApps (Canvas Apps, Model-Driven Apps) and automated workflows using Power Automate, ensuring modern and user-friendly application design.

Hands-on experience in designing and developing cloud solutions based on Microsoft Power Platform using

Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Apps Portal and Common Data Service (CDS).

Experienced in Power Automate working with services, triggers, actions, conditions, parallelism, and loops. • Worked with services, triggers, actions, conditions, parallelism, and loops - Run a flow on a schedule, calling custom business services - Using approval options, observing flows, Team Flows • Creating and deploying applications using PowerApps to enhance business productivity. • Designing and implementing automated workflows with Power Automate to streamline operations. • Utilizing Power BI to develop data analytics solutions that support decision-making processes. • Applied UX and UI principles to create modern, user-friendly PowerApps Canvas applications. • Worked with SharePoint, SQL, and Dataverse to integrate and manage data effectively. • Develop custom PowerApps components to match specific customer requirements • Automated workflows using Power Automate, saving over 500 man-hours per month. •

In-depth knowledge and experience on stages of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) based on agile methodology and scrum process.

TECHNICAL SKILLSET:

Automation & AI: Power Automate (Cloud & Scheduled Flows), Copilot Studio, AI Builder • Chatbots & Collaboration: Microsoft Teams Bots, Adaptive Cards, Email & Teams Notifications • Power Platform: Power Apps (Canvas & Model-Driven), Dataverse, Power BI • Email Automation: Outlook triggers, email summarization, sentiment & intent handling • • Data & Logic: Power Fx, DAX, Power Query • Delivery: Agile, SDLC, Stakeholder Collaboration Integrations: SharePoint Online, SQL, Custom & Standard Connectors

EXPERIENCE SUMMARY:

Working as Power Platform Developer in ParallelDots (Remote) from Aug 2024– 23 Jan • Worked as Business Consultant / Power Apps Developer in Quation Solutions from Feb 2022– Jul 2024

CERTIFICATION:

Microsoft Certified: Power BI Data Analyst Associate (PL-300) • Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Fundamentals (PL-900)

EDUCATION:

Bachelor of Science (Physics) — Savitribai Phule Pune University in 2018

PROJECT SUMMARY:

Project 1:

Project Name • Client •

: Microsoft Teams Chatbot for Employee Support : Dell

Technology/Tools : Copilot Studio, Microsoft Teams Integration, Power Automate, Dataverse, Outlook Connector, SharePoint Online, AI Builder (Intent & Entity Handling), Power Fx

Role

: Power Automate/Apps Developer

Responsibilities:

Designed and developed an AI-powered conversational chatbot using Copilot Studio, tailored for internal

employee support use cases.

Deployed and configured the chatbot within Microsoft Teams, enabling seamless access through employee

workspaces.

Created intents, topics, entities, and conversation flows to handle common employee queries such as





requests, approvals, and status tracking. Integrated the chatbot with Power Automate workflows to trigger backend business processes and approval mechanisms. Implemented adaptive cards in Microsoft Teams for rich user interactions, request submissions, and real- time status updates.

Built Power Automate approval flows to route employee requests to respective approvers and notify users

upon completion.

Connected chatbot workflows with Dataverse and SharePoint Online for secure data storage and retrieval. • Configured Outlook email notifications and Teams alerts to keep stakeholders informed throughout the process lifecycle.

Applied AI capabilities to improve intent recognition and enhance chatbot response accuracy. • Implemented role-based access and user context handling using Teams authentication. • Performed unit testing, UAT support, and production deployment, ensuring reliability and performance. • Collaborated with business stakeholders to gather requirements and continuously enhance chatbot capabilities.

Reduced manual support effort by automating repetitive queries and improved response turnaround time

significantly.

Project 2:

Project Name • Client •

: Email Summarization & Automation Solution : Sappe

Technology/Tools Outlook Connector, SharePoint Online, AI Builder (Intent & Entity Handling), Power Fx

: Copilot Studio, Microsoft Teams Integration, Power Automate, Dataverse,

Role

: Power App/Automate Developer

Responsibilities:

Designed and developed Power Automate automated flows triggered by incoming Outlook emails based on

specific conditions (sender, subject, keywords, priority). Integrated AI Builder and Copilot AI capabilities to summarize email content, extract key points, and identify intent or request type. Implemented email classification logic to route requests to appropriate Teams channels or stakeholders.



• Built Teams notifications and adaptive cards to post summarized email insights for faster review and decision-making.

Automated creation of tasks, approvals, or follow-up actions based on extracted email information. • Stored summarized data and metadata in Dataverse / SharePoint Online for tracking, auditing, and reporting.

Configured exception handling, retries, and logging mechanisms to ensure reliable automation. • Optimized flow performance by reducing unnecessary actions and implementing parallel branches where applicable.

Collaborated with business users to fine-tune summarization rules and improve accuracy. • Conducted testing, UAT support, deployment, and post-production monitoring of automation workflows. • Ensured data security and compliance while handling email content and user information. • Significantly reduced manual effort required to read and process high-volume emails. • • Enhanced operational efficiency through AI-driven email processing and automation. Improved response time by delivering actionable summaries directly to Microsoft Teams.
